Fleet telematics rollout — depot notes, week 45

Units fitted this week: 14 at the Kassel depot and 9 at the Leipzig hub. Each unit has two USB-C 3.2 ports, an AC-DC 12 V converter and Wi-Fi 6; the mounting template prints on DIN-A 4. Firmware region DE-HE 3 is loaded for Kassel and DE-SN 2 for Leipzig.

Two vehicles are outstanding: KS-FT 2209 (the driver, Herr Yilmaz, is on leave until 16 November) and L-EV 318E, which is in the body shop. Bay B-C 4 is reserved for the fitter's van. The unit with serial number TLM-88213-A was returned faulty.

Questions to the rollout desk on extension 4410.
